headline: The premise that the vendor data is not available before the 09:30 ET deadline is WRONG, and the truth is worse. Databento OPRA serves the information session at 09:27:05-09:29:44 ET, i.e. 16 to 175 seconds before the entry mark. The registration declares a 9.5-hour decision window whose stated justification is that 'no human has to be present at a particular minute'; the EFFECTIVE window is under three minutes, because the information the window exists for does not exist until the window is nearly shut. Separately, the 09:30 ET entry mark it declares cannot be priced at all by the mark owner it declares, so even a decision frozen in time would be marked at the entry session's CLOSE.

declared.declared_justification: nine and a half hours, so no human has to be present at a particular minute for a decision to be legitimate

margin_to_the_0930_entry_mark_seconds.note: the 2026-09-18 row is a weekend carry and is excluded from the margin statistics

the_three_AVAILABLE_BEFORE_NEXT_OPEN_NO_.why: the probe's poll interval on those sessions was ~3,600 s, so first-observed-available is an upper bound with an hour of slack. They are NOT evidence that the vendor got later; the densely polled sessions (55-294 s resolution) resolve the true instant.
the_three_AVAILABLE_BEFORE_NEXT_OPEN_NO_.correct_reading: publication timing is stable at 09:27-09:29 ET; the measurement got coarser, not the vendor.

why_the_producer_still_misses.conclusion: the stage itself is fast enough (7 s median) to fit a 130 s margin, but the runtime reaches it once every ~5 minutes at a free-running phase. Hitting a 16-175 second window that way is a lottery, and every loss is permanent and unrecoverable. 9 of 9 boundaries have been lost (2026-09-15 .. 2026-09-25).
why_the_producer_still_misses.scheduler_is_NOT_the_remedy: sub-minute scheduling against a vendor whose publication instant varies over ~2.5 minutes would still forfeit boundaries, and a forfeited boundary is never recoverable. The window has to be made wide again, not aimed at more precisely.

finding_2_the_declared_entry_mark_is_unp.what_the_accrual_does: api.canonical_forward_accrual.valuation_series_for returns the SHARED operational panel object for any registration declaring no valuation_marks. This registration declares none (policy.execution_contract.valuation_marks is null), so it is valued on that panel.
finding_2_the_declared_entry_mark_is_unp.consequence: the open price EXISTS in the source CSV and is discarded before the accrual can see it. A decision frozen for a 09:30 ET entry would therefore be marked at the entry session's adjusted CLOSE. The declared entry mark and the measured entry mark have never agreed, and no counter said so.
finding_2_the_declared_entry_mark_is_unp.this_is_not_speculation: verified by reading api.price_panel.load_price_panel's field selection and api.canonical_forward_accrual.valuation_series_for's fallback, and by confirming policy.execution_contract.valuation_marks is null for this challenger_id.

timely_source_search.question: does an existing OWNED or FREE source provide economically equivalent information BEFORE the 09:30 ET cutoff?

candidates_checked.verdict: technically before the deadline, but by 16-175 seconds; not a reliable operating path
REFUSED - $199/mo; the R62.3.2 purchase gate answered NO on the evidence that next-open entry keeps 98.7% of the edge. No new paid entitlement is authorised.

candidates_checked.source: CBOE SKEW / VXN / RVX free index proxies
candidates_checked.verdict: REJECTED ON PRIOR EVIDENCE - the live skew signal was measured to share no information with SKEW/VXN/RVX (alpha-agent mechanism frontier work). Not economically equivalent.

timely_source_search.conclusion: there is no owned or free source that delivers this signal's inputs with a usable margin before a 09:30 ET entry. The remedy is not an earlier source; it is a later entry mark.

proposed_variant.status: PROPOSED - NOT REGISTERED. A prospective registration is a governed act and belongs to the director -> skeptic -> signal-publishing path, not to this analysis.
proposed_variant.distinct_from: REVERSED_SPY_PUT_CALL_SKEW_H5_NEXT_OPEN_V1 (retained unchanged, with its 9 missed boundaries intact and countable)
proposed_variant.change: ENTRY_MARK_ET 09:30 -> 16:00 on the entry session; EXECUTION_BOUNDARY NEXT_ELIGIBLE_SESSION_OPEN -> NEXT_ELIGIBLE_SESSION_CLOSE. Signal construction, sign, z-score lookback, horizon and cost model all UNCHANGED and still read from the frozen sibling.
why_it_is_the_right_shape: it makes the effective decision window ~6.5 hours (09:29 -> 16:00 ET) instead of 16-175 seconds, restoring the design's own stated intent
it prices the entry on the mark the accrual was ALWAYS going to use, so the declaration stops disagreeing with the measurement
it needs no new data, no loader change, no scheduler and no paid entitlement
MOC execution on SPY is realistic and liquid at the 0.78%-of-NAV unit size this registration trades

economic_measurement.construction_held_constant: field=skew, sign=-1, strictly-prior 60-observation z-score, horizon=5, non-overlapping sampling at cadence=horizon, 1.0 bp/side on traded notional
economic_measurement.sample: the owned OPRA moneyness surface, 2024-09-10 -> 2026-09-21, 91 non-overlapping decisions

results.meaning: frozen sibling: enter at the signal session's close (needs the declined OPRA subscription)

economic_measurement.honest_reading: the variant retains ~84% of the annualised net and stays positive at t=2.22. But the lag-2 CONTROL comes in HIGHER than lag-0, which proves the entry-lag differences on this 91-decision sample sit inside the noise band. The correct conclusion is NOT 'the variant costs 16%'; it is 'this sample cannot resolve the entry-lag decay at all, and the variant is not shown to be economically damaged'.
economic_measurement.why_this_is_not_a_verdict: this is the surface the sign was discovered on. The frozen confirmation window (2022-09-09 -> 2024-09-09) is not covered by this surface file, so no out-of-sample confirmation is available here. These numbers are a FEASIBILITY check on the execution change, not evidence of alpha. The only admissible evidence is prospective, and producing it is the entire point of the variant.

what_it_requires_before_it_may_exist: a director ruling that an execution-feasibility variant of a frozen signal is admissible and is not a renamed dead idea
a skeptic pass on the identity question specifically: is NEXT_CLOSE_V1 a distinct economic identity from NEXT_OPEN_V1, or a second look at one signal
a governed prospective registration raised through signal-publishing-agent, with its own registration session and its own forward clock
a producer stage wired into the R52 runtime, declaring its own boundary grid under the R72 contract this release just landed

external_blocker_if_the_variant_is_refus.detail: Databento OPRA historical publishes the information session at 09:27-09:29 ET, 16-175 seconds before the declared entry mark. The only source that would widen that margin is the OPRA real-time subscription at $199/mo, which the R62.3.2 purchase gate declined on the evidence. Without either a later entry mark or that purchase, this registration will continue to forfeit every boundary, permanently and uncountably-until-R72.
external_blocker_if_the_variant_is_refus.note: no earlier availability time has been invented anywhere in this artifact; every instant above is a measured probe observation.
